levels.surface: محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى بن عمران الأشعري

notes: عن أخيه عمر: the brother's relation is folded into the name (rule 7), so the link is «عمر».
The father at the start (أبي رحمه الله) is a relation link.
The Imam al-Rida is written after «عن» and speaks; he stays a narrator and is the last link (owner ruling 2).
